shots.visual_event: Meera hijacks every station speaker while Maya displays Rohan’s cyan exchange result across public departure boards.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “The train will take whole lives unless we choose smaller losses together.”

shots.visual_event: Nila broadcasts the opposite offer from the engine: surrender nothing and she will return everyone by force.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nila: “Why should the living keep everything?”

shots.visual_event: A nurse offers the memory of her first day in uniform; a baker offers one recipe; a porter offers the score of a childhood match.
shots.dialogue_audio: Nurse: “I understand the cost. I consent.”

shots.visual_event: Hundreds refuse and step back—shown without shame—while thousands who accept write one chosen memory on blank brass slips.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “A choice is not consent if no is forbidden.”

shots.visual_event: The slips glow cyan across the city, each tiny contribution flowing toward Central Station without erasing any person.
Nila sees the engine’s red balance fall from one life to thousands of freely given memories.
